claim: Caves Bernard-Massard in Grevenmacher offers ~1-hour guided cellar tours with audiovisual presentation and tasting, Wednesday to Sunday, April to end of October, from €8 (1 glass) for adults and €5 for children 3-15, bookable online.
quote: Availability: from Wednesday to Sunday, April to the end of October. ... Individual visit with tasting (1 glass): €8.00 per person. Children ages 3-15: €5.00.

claim: MS Princesse Marie-Astrid Moselle cruises cost €24 per adult, with under-6 free, under-12 half-price, and bicycles transported free of charge subject to capacity.
quote: Price per adult: 24 euros incl. VAT ... Under 6 years: complimentary ... Under 12 years: 50% reduction ... Bicycles: transported at no charge (subject to capacity)

claim: The MS Princesse Marie-Astrid runs a fixed Easter-to-September timetable from its Grevenmacher base, calling at Wasserbillig, Wormeldange, Stadtbredimus, Remich, Bech-Kleinmacher and Schengen as well as Trier.
quote: There are several stops between Trier (Germany), Wasserbillig, Grevenmacher, Wormeldange, Stadtbredimus, Remich, Bech-Kleinmacher and Schengen.

claim: Remich's quay is the home port of Navitours, which operates the River Diva, Roude Léiw and Muselschëff for shorter Moselle excursions alongside the Marie-Astrid.
quote: Navitours ... Vessels: River Diva (82 meters), Roude Léiw, and Muselschëff ... Address: Quai de la Moselle, L-5553 Remich

claim: Caves St Martin in Remich runs 75-90 minute guided tours through nearly a kilometre of limestone tunnels at a constant 12°C, with a Discovery tasting of one Crémant plus two Grand Premier Cru wines for roughly €12-15, by reservation 48 hours ahead.
quote: Guided tours including tasting cost around €12–15 ... walk through underground tunnels—nearly a kilometre long—carved into solid limestone rock ... temperature in the tunnels is a constant, damp 12°C ... Reservations have to be made 48 hours in advance.

claim: Domaine Mathis Bastian, a five-generation family estate on the Primerberg/Wellenstein slopes above Remich, accepts cellar visits and tastings by appointment from April to September.
quote: Visits of the vineyard and the cellar can be reserved from April to September. Visits and tastings can be organized on appointment.

claim: Domaine Alice Hartmann in Wormeldange (rue Principale 72-74) is open for visits by appointment, typically Friday afternoons, and is renowned for its Wormeldange Koeppchen Riesling and Crémant served at the Grand-Duc's table.
quote: The domaine is open for visits on Friday afternoon ... open to the public by appointment ... Domaine Alice Hartmann's Crémants are served at Luxembourg's most prestigious occasions, including parliamentary functions and even at the Grand-Duc's table.

claim: Domaine Cep d'Or in Hettermillen offers tastings and a Tire-Bouchon wine bar/restaurant in a Valentiny-designed building with a panoramic Moselle terrace, with a Vinothèque selling its wines and Crémants.
quote: Visitors can enjoy time with friends or family in the wine bar "Tire-Bouchon" ... one of the most beautiful terraces in the region with an unobstructed view of the Moselle and its vineyards.

claim: Domaines Vinsmoselle, Luxembourg's biggest cooperative producer (since 1921) and home of the Poll-Fabaire Crémant brand in Wormeldange, prices individual tastings from €10, Discovery Tastings €12.50, children's tastings €4.50, age 16+ only.
quote: Individual tastings start at 10€, with Discovery Tastings at 12.50€ and Children Tastings (3-15 years) at 4.50€ ... Wine tastings are only possible for people aged 16 and over.

claim: Musée A Possen, the folklore-wine-and-toy museum in Bech-Kleinmacher housed in seven traditional Moselle houses, is open Tuesday to Sunday 10:00-18:00, €5 adults, children free.
quote: Tuesday to Sunday from 10:00 til 18:00. ... Adults: €5 ... Children: Free

claim: The Schengen European Museum, dedicated to the Schengen Agreement at the Luxembourg-France-Germany triangle, is open daily 10:00-18:00 (last entry 17:30), with brief 2026 closures on 9-13 March and an early 3 p.m. close on 27 April.
quote: Open today 10:00 – 18:00 ... March 9-13, 2026: The museum will be closed ... April 27, 2026: The museum will close at 3 p.m.

claim: The Ehnen Wine Museum (Wäinhaus) remains closed for renovation into 2026 with no announced reopening date; when operating, admission was €3.50 adults / €1.50 children with a complimentary wine or juice glass.
quote: The Wine Museum closed its doors for renovation ... Adults: €3.50 (includes wine glass) ... Children under 15: €1.50 (includes juice glass)

claim: The Wormeldange Koeppchen (250m altitude) is one of the most celebrated panoramic viewpoints over the Luxembourg Moselle, with a 1925-1927 chapel to St Donatus and a south-facing shell-limestone Riesling vineyard of national renown.
quote: panoramic view over the village of Wormeldange ... the Moselle valley, and the village of Wincheringen on the other side of the Moselle ... one of the most beautiful and popular viewpoints of the Luxembourgish Moselle ... chapel built in 1925 in honor of Saint Donatus

claim: RentaBike Miselerland offers cheap regional bike rental with free helmet at outlets including Remich Esplanade and Schengen (6 rue Robert Goebbels), and bikes can be returned to any participating outlet on the flat Moselle cycle path.
quote: The regional bicycle hire service RentaBike miselerland is practical, simple and cheap to use ... offers free use of a helmet along with your bike ... Bikes can be returned to any participating outlet.
